sites.source: https://wvdnr.gov/lands-waters/wildlife-management-areas/district-2-wildlife-management-areas/ ('26. Nathaniel Mountain ... On the WMA: campsites – tent/trailer, 75 primitive; vault toilets; trash facility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Primitive WV DNR tent/trailer campsites in a mountain WMA southeast of Romney, entrance road off Grassy Lick Road (CR 10); no significant water body adjacent. --Claude
summary: WV DNR's District 2 WMA list gives Nathaniel Mountain '75 primitive' tent/trailer campsites, vault toilets and a trash facility: sites count 75 and vault toilets recorded. The DNR map (2022) marks campground symbols (not general dispersed camping) and parking areas. DNR silent on fees, reservations and season. Note corrected: these are DNR-designated campsites, not dispersed camping.
flags: Name/character: DNR describes designated campsites ('campsites – tent/trailer, 75 primitive') and its WMA map marks 'Campground' symbols, not dispersed camping anywhere; suggest renaming to 'Nathaniel Mountain WMA Campground'. This is agency-designated camping (qualifies under the wildlife-agency rule), not parking-lot camping, so the open WMA parking-lot question in asks.md does not apply.

Pin check: the WVDNR map shows a campground symbol near the northeast end by the entrance road from Grassy Lick Road (CR 10) and another mid-ridge beside a parking area; the stored point (39.2498,-78.7506) could not be matched to either from the map alone. Worth a satellite check.

Website is DNR's generic WMA index (https://wvdnr.gov/lands-waters/wildlife-management-areas/); better: https://wvdnr.gov/lands-waters/wildlife-management-areas/district-2-wildlife-management-areas/ plus the map PDF above. Missing phone: WV DNR District 2 office, Romney, (304) 822-3551 (same page).
No DNR statement on fees, season or how a 23-ft motorhome fares; 'tent/trailer' is the only rig wording.
